name: WhiteTiger
prompt:
Create a production pixel art mount animation spritesheet for a Terraria mod faithfully converting the referenced Milkcraft blocky creature into detailed side-view pixel art. Reference image 1 is the original creature design to reproduce; reference image 2 is STYLE ONLY, the accepted existing mount sheet. No rider, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no backgrounds, genuine transparent alpha. Exactly 16 separated complete sprites in a regular 4-column 4-row grid, all facing RIGHT, all same scale and fixed saddle position within their cells. Wide landscape 2048x1536 sheet. Each cell 512x384, sprite drawn in large crisp 4px pixel clusters, designed to reduce to about 105x78 logical pixels. Preserve original color shapes, blocky broad anatomy, saddle, armor details, bright highlights and dark shadow planes. Consistent torso/head/saddle across frames; change legs and tail without stretching the entire body. First sprite standing, then eight distinct successive smooth gallop phases spanning frames 1-8; frame 9 leaping with legs tucked, last six frames sprint/gallop followthrough. Each sprite wholly inside own cell with transparent gutters. Visible separate four legs with believable joints/paws or hooves, detailed shading without soft blur, no anti-aliasing and NO floating external glow halos. Saddle's top midpoint identical in every cell, reasonable room for seated player's legs. Exclude wings unless source has them; these mounts do not fly.
Broad white saber-toothed tiger; pale ice-blue polygon stripes, two prominent long ivory upper canine fangs, dark blue ear tips and nose, blue paws/toe pads, blue gold-edged high backed squared saddle and hanging blue cloth exactly from original. Strong compact tiger proportions, long white tail with dark blue curled tip. Must look like original, not a striped Bengal tiger or furry realistic tiger.
